concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-getting-paid-scheduled-payouts]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service Customer Area guide for role/capability-gated custom balance-account sweeps to a verified bank instrument; a configured or triggered schedule is not debit or bank-receipt proof.
